result.description:
Company – Larnec Pty Ltd t/a Larnec Doors and Systems
  

Position  : Full Time
Location : Swan Hill, VIC 
Salary     : $75,000 - $85,000 a year
  
  
Larnec is a family-owned, Australian company specialising in the manufacture of high quality pre-hung door solutions, with a keen focus on quality. They have grown into one of the largest manufacturers and suppliers of pre-hung door solutions in the industry, supplier to some of the most respected companies across the shed and garage, industrial, commercial, transportable building and shipping container modification industries. They are located in Tullamarine, Vic, Swan Hill, Vic and Rockdale NSW.
  
Larnec is currently looking for hardworking and dedicated Supply Chain Analyst to join their team in Victoria.
  
Duties and Responsibilities:
Collect, analyze, and interpret supply chain data to identify trends and opportunities for improvement.
Monitor inventory levels and recommend optimal stock quantities.
Analyze demand forecasts and support inventory planning.
Evaluate supplier performance, including delivery, quality, and cost metrics.
Prepare reports and dashboards on key supply chain performance indicators (KPIs).
Collaborate with procurement, production, logistics, and sales teams to improve operational efficiency.
Identify supply chain risks and recommend mitigation strategies.
Support transportation and distribution planning to optimize delivery performance.
Assist in developing and implementing process improvements to reduce costs and improve service levels.
Ensure data accuracy in enterprise systems such as ERP, WMS, and inventory management software.
Participate in budgeting, cost analysis, and supply chain projects.
Monitor compliance with company policies and relevant industry regulations.
  
Required Experience, Skills and Qualifications:
Bachelor's degree in Supply Chain Management, Logistics, Business Administration, Operations Management, Industrial Engineering, or a related field.
At least 2 years relevant working experience
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Excel
Excellent communication and presentation skills.
Work Health Safety (WHS) knowledge
  

If you meet the above criteria, please apply now. Only shortlisted candidates will be contacted.
